title: Routing-failure-status-themed large explicit request analogue
target_operation: Routing Failure Request Packet Too Large
purpose: Exercise larger yet internally consistent SendRRData and CPF lengths with a longer unconnected explicit payload, using the documented general-status name only as thematic coverage rather than an expected result.
expected_behavior: Parser should accept the encapsulation and CPF framing and pass a larger unconnected explicit request upward; any returned CIP general status is implementation dependent and not prescribed by this seed.
constraints_preserved: Used encapsulation command 0x006f SendRRData and documented 24-byte header form.
Set encapsulation payload length to 0x0025 matching the CPF payload byte count.
Used documented CPF pair Null Address Item plus Unconnected Data Item.
Set Unconnected Data Item length to 0x0019 matching the 25-byte CIP request carried inside.
Used a conservative inferred CIP message layout with service byte 0x0e, path size 2 words, path to class 0x01 instance 0x01, and 16 bytes of request data to increase parser coverage.
Referenced the documented status name 'Routing Failure Request Packet Too Large' only as plan context; this request is not claimed to produce that status.
issue_safety_notes: No issue behavior is claimed. The sequence is intended only to broaden parser coverage with a larger valid frame.
